research_mode: official MHCLG accredited statistical bulletin only; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: False alarms due to apparatus
verified_claims: There were 172,247 fire false alarms due to apparatus, 2.6% fewer than the previous year.
limitations: Apparatus-related false alarms do not indicate an actual fire at a parcel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: Good-intent false alarms
verified_claims: There were 77,181 good-intent fire false alarms, 13% more than the previous year.
limitations: Good-intent calls are based on a belief that a fire exists and are not confirmed fire events.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: Malicious false alarms
verified_claims: There were 5,619 malicious fire false alarms, 2.1% fewer than the previous year.
limitations: The national count does not locate calls or measure neighbourhood safety.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: Non-fire incidents
verified_claims: Fire and rescue services attended 215,583 non-fire incidents, the largest financial-year figure since consistent data became available.
limitations: Non-fire incidents cover diverse activities and must not be treated as a single hazard measure.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: Collaboration incidents
verified_claims: Collaboration incidents reached 75,060 and accounted for 35% of non-fire incidents in the year ending March 2026.
limitations: Collaboration activity is influenced by multi-agency practice and does not directly measure local danger.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: Effecting entry or exit
verified_claims: Effecting entry or exit was the largest collaboration category, with 41,130 incidents, 3.1% more than the previous year.
limitations: This service activity does not identify the cause, severity or parcel-level risk of each incident.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: Medical incidents
verified_claims: Medical incidents totalled 10,602 and represented 4.9% of non-fire incidents.
limitations: Medical response arrangements and trial participation affect comparability over time and place.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: Road traffic collision incidents
verified_claims: Fire and rescue services attended 32,713 road traffic collision incidents, representing 15% of non-fire incidents.
limitations: Road traffic collision attendance is network-based and cannot be attributed to a parcel without exact geospatial evidence.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: Flooding and water rescue incidents
verified_claims: There were 17,502 flooding and rescue-or-evacuation-from-water incidents, including 15,920 flooding incidents and 1,582 water rescue or evacuation incidents.
limitations: These categories cover broad incident types and do not prove flood exposure for a specific property.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: No-action or advice incidents
verified_claims: No-action or advice incidents totalled 21,587 in the year ending March 2026.
limitations: A no-action outcome can reflect many circumstances and is not evidence of a safe or unsafe location.
